column1: # vm-iap-ports.tsv — the VM-side TCP ports that need an IAP firewall rule.
# Google's IAP forwarder (35.235.240.0/20) reaches a VM port only through a VPC rule for that exact
# port, one rule per port. The rules are named lupin-iap-<port>. This file is the single list.
#   src/scripts/lupin-vm.sh firewall ensure   creates each missing rule (a person runs it)
#   src/scripts/lupin-vm.sh firewall check    read-only: every port below has a rule
#   src/scripts/lupin-vm.sh deploy            runs the check before and after a deploy
# Format: tab-separated, 3 columns. '#' comments and blank lines are ignored.
#   tier      block = a missing rule fails the check; warn = a missing rule only warns
